operation: One bounded metadata query, two direct selected SQL checks, six HTTP checks each on staging and public (two full responses per target), and a reserve for one rollback/retry cycle. No DB writes/imports.
plan: Workers account and existing Worker usage_model are standard. Billing-subscription API is denied to the existing OAuth credential, so use the smaller verified published Free limits with no paid-plan headroom.
stop: Abort on schema/index mismatch, SQL reads above preallocated case limits, unknown query costs, nonzero writes, failed verification or account allowance too small. Refresh usage immediately before each deployment.
